newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants subordinated debt cut.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants subordinated debt cut.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it cut the $51.75 million of First Merchants Acceptance Corp's subordinated debt due 2006 to single-B from double-B.
The cut comes due to the auto financing company's discovery of unauthorized accounting entries, Duff & Phelps said.

Although the amount of the accounting problems may be manageable, the revelation has created a breach of trust with the investment community, which could pose a significant challenge for the company in obtaining future funding, Duff & Phelps said.

"We are favorably impressed with the new, interim management team appointed by the board and by some key operating personnel remaining at the company, preserving continuity," the rating agency said. "To our knowledge, field operations and dealer relationships have not been hurt by these revelations."
